extracted.summary: Senior Rust engineer building payment infrastructure at a UK fintech. Remote-first with quarterly meetups.

fit.preference_summary: Remote-first with quarterly meetups matches the stated want, and the £90-110k range clears the floor. The six-stage process runs against the preference for a short pipeline.

suggestions.advice:
Lead with the payments work: their core stack is the one you rebuilt, and that is a stronger opening than the language match everyone else will claim.

Address Kafka before they raise it - naming the adjacent queue work you have done reads as candour rather than a gap. Ask about the six-stage process up front, so you can judge the timeline before investing in it.
gaps: No Kafka, which the posting lists as nice-to-have
Kubernetes evidence is thin against a stack that assumes it
strengths: Production Rust at the scale the role describes
Payments domain experience the posting is built around

fit.notes: Strong core-skills match; the missing Kafka experience is listed as nice-to-have.
